name: Foundation & Platform Kernel
intent: Build the platform every module stands on: Kubernetes delivery pipeline, identity and tenancy, the metadata/extensibility kernel (our AOT/DDIC), Kafka eventing and workflow, audit and the UX shell. Nothing business-facing ships until this layer can deploy, observe and roll back safely.

name: Enterprise Structure, Master Data & Engineering Data
intent: Model the enterprise (legal entities, sites, org hierarchies), the shared party/business-partner model, products and variants, BOMs/routings (engineering data a manufacturer needs on day one), and the migration framework every later wave uses to load legacy AX/SAP data.

name: Financial Core
intent: Stand up a single append-only universal journal (one source of truth, like SAP ACDOCA / AX GeneralJournalAccountEntry) with dimensions, multi-currency, parallel ledgers, tax, period close and financial reporting. Every later module posts through this engine.

name: Inventory & Procure-to-Pay
intent: Inventory ledger and costing, purchasing, receiving with three-way match, accounts payable and payments, supplier collaboration. Physical goods start moving and valuing correctly into the GL.

name: Manufacturing & Planning
intent: Production orders and WIP, MRP/MPS, capacity and scheduling, process and lean manufacturing, shop-floor execution and IoT. A discrete or process manufacturer can build product on Passage.

name: Order-to-Cash
intent: Pricing, sales orders with ATP, fulfillment, billing and revenue recognition, accounts receivable and collections. At the end of wave 30 a manufacturer runs the full buy-make-sell-collect loop on Passage — the first go-live milestone.

name: Warehouse, Quality & Logistics
intent: Advanced warehouse management, mobile execution, quality management, transportation and B2B/EDI/e-invoicing integration.

name: Treasury, Assets & Controlling
intent: Cash and bank, fixed assets, cost accounting and budgeting, standard-cost variance analysis, intercompany and consolidation. The finance function reaches full AX/SAP parity.

name: Projects, People & Service
intent: Project operations, HR core, payroll and expenses, enterprise asset management and field service.

name: Intelligence, Compliance & Go-Live
intent: Data platform and analytics, AI copilots and agents, globalization and compliance, then the migration factory, scale hardening and production cutover off AX/SAP.
